description: Defines the OpaqueTensorImpl class template, a specialized implementation of TensorImpl for opaque tensors without strides or data pointers, including methods for shallow copying and resource management.

classes.name: OpaqueTensorImpl
classes.description: A template class for opaque tensor implementations that do not support strides or data pointers, providing shallow copy and resource management functionalities.

methods.name: release_resources
methods.description: Releases resources and resets the opaque handle.

methods.name: set_size
methods.description: Throws an error as opaque tensors do not support resizing.

methods.name: set_stride
methods.description: Throws an error as opaque tensors do not support setting stride.

methods.name: set_storage_offset
methods.description: Throws an error as opaque tensors do not support storage offset.

methods.name: has_storage
methods.description: Asserts that storage is never set for opaque tensors.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor implementation, optionally with a new version counter.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies tensor metadata from another TensorImpl.

methods.name: opaque_handle
methods.description: Returns the opaque handle associated with the tensor.

methods.name: unsafe_opaque_handle
methods.description: Returns a mutable reference to the opaque handle.
